notice: Publication baselines only. The newest publication is NOT a default target. Agents must resolve the target version per project (see docs/version-strategy.md). Entries marked verify:true must be re-checked against the publisher before being cited as authoritative.

standards.name: DICOM
standards.versioning: Edition per year with letter suffix (YYYYa..YYYYe). Editions are cumulative; Final Text supplements and CPs land in a specific edition. Products declare support via a Conformance Statement (PS3.2), not an edition number.

retiredFeatures.feature: Explicit VR Big Endian transfer syntax (1.2.840.10008.1.2.2)
retiredFeatures.note: Still encountered in legacy archives; accept on read only if the conformance statement requires it.

versionDetection: (0008,0016) SOP Class UID against the PS3.4/PS3.6 registry of the target edition

standards.name: DICOMweb (PS3.18)
standards.versioning: Published as DICOM Part 18 inside each DICOM edition.
versionDetection: Presence of UPS-RS, rendered, thumbnail endpoints

standards.name: DICOM Security and System Management (PS3.15)
standards.versioning: Published as DICOM Part 15 inside each DICOM edition (TLS secure transport profiles, audit trail, de-identification profiles in Annex E).
versionDetection: Declared Basic Application Level Confidentiality Profile options

standards.name: HL7 Version 2.x
standards.versioning: Point releases (2.1 .. 2.9.1). Mostly backward compatible by design (new fields appended, elements deprecated/withdrawn over time). Real interfaces are governed by site-specific implementation specs and Z-segments more than by the base version.

standards.name: HL7 Version 3 (RIM-based messaging)
standards.versioning: Normative Edition releases; domain-specific interaction/message model publications. Mostly legacy outside specific national programmes; CDA R2 is the most widely deployed V3-derived artifact.

standards.name: HL7 FHIR
standards.versioning: Major releases are NOT wire-compatible (DSTU2, STU3, R4, R4B, R5, R6). Implementation Guides pin their own FHIR version independently of the latest core release. Always resolve core version AND each IG version.
standards.inDevelopment: R6 (ballot/development track; not interchangeable with R5)

implementationGuides.name: US Core
implementationGuides.note: Regulatory programmes may reference an older US Core version; resolve per programme.

implementationGuides.name: Subscriptions R5 Backport
implementationGuides.note: Use for topic-based subscriptions on R4/R4B servers.

standards.name: HL7 CDA
standards.versioning: CDA R2.0 is the deployed base; CDA R2.1 exists but is rarely used.
versionDetection: Schema used for validation (CDA.xsd + SDTC extensions)

standards.name: C-CDA (Consolidated CDA)
standards.versioning: Template versions are identified by templateId @root + @extension (a date). A document may mix template versions; validate each templateId against the release that defines it.
versionDetection: templateId @root/@extension pairs on ClinicalDocument, sections and entries

standards.name: IHE IT Infrastructure (ITI) Technical Framework
standards.versioning: Technical Framework revision numbers plus separately published Trial Implementation supplements. Profiles have actor/transaction options; FHIR-based profiles (MHD, PIXm, PDQm, mXDE) pin a FHIR version.
versionDetection: Transaction numbers in use (e.g. ITI-41, ITI-43)

standards.name: IHE Radiology (RAD) Technical Framework
standards.versioning: Technical Framework revision numbers plus Trial Implementation supplements. SWF is superseded by SWF.b.
versionDetection: Use of HL7 v2.5.1 OMI vs v2.3.1 ORM (SWF vs SWF.b)

standards.name: HIPAA Administrative Simplification (US)
standards.versioning: Regulation text as amended (45 CFR Parts 160, 162, 164). Not a technical spec: it mandates outcomes and, for transactions, adopts specific standard versions (Part 162).
standards.latestPublished: Current applicable regulations (check eCFR for amendments and pending rules)

adoptedTransactionStandards.note: Adopted version for HIPAA transactions; newer X12 publications are NOT automatically mandated.
Retail pharmacy transactions; verify any newly adopted version and compliance date.

versionDetection: Compliance date of any rule in force on the target date

standards.name: ASC X12 (Healthcare EDI)
standards.versioning: Release numbers (004010, 005010, ... 008070). Healthcare usage is governed by TR3 implementation guides whose IDs embed version and errata (e.g. 005010X222A1).

standards.name: NCPDP (SCRIPT, Telecommunication, RTPB, Formulary & Benefit)
standards.versioning: Each NCPDP standard is versioned independently. Regulatory use is set by CMS rule with specific compliance dates; multiple versions may be legitimately in production during transitions.

milestones.item: RTPB v13 and Formulary & Benefit v60 for applicable regulated use cases
SCRIPT 2023011 for applicable Part D use cases (SCRIPT 2017071 applies before that date)

versionDetection: SCRIPT XML Message @version / TransportVersion / ECLVersion header attributes

standards.name: ISO/IEEE 11073 family
standards.versioning: Family of independently versioned standards: PHD (-20601 optimized exchange, -104xx device specializations), SDC (-10207, -20701, -20702), nomenclature (-10101). Device specializations reference a specific -20601 version.

standards.name: Clinical terminologies (SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, ICD, UCUM, DICOM CID)
standards.publisher: SNOMED International, Regenstrief, NLM, WHO/CDC/CMS, UCUM, NEMA
standards.versioning: Each code system has its own release cadence and edition (e.g. SNOMED CT International vs national editions, ICD-10-CM fiscal year effective 1 October, RxNorm monthly, LOINC semi-annual). Code validity depends on the release in force at the date of service.
standards.latestPublished: Varies by code system; always resolve edition + release date
standards.licensingNote: SNOMED CT requires an affiliate licence outside member territories; LOINC and RxNorm have their own terms; CPT is AMA-licensed. Never embed licensed content in this repository.
versionDetection: HL7 v2 CWE-7/CWE-8 coding system version ID
